rationale: Despite the broader market slipping further to -4.05%, the pullback from the $13.89 session high has occurred on contracting volume (dropping to ~2.8k shares per minute), indicating a normal consolidation rather than aggressive institutional distribution. Price remains above both the rising 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.78) and our hard invalidation level ($13.80), leaving the intraday structure and upside thesis intact. We will hold the position and let the $13.80 invalidation level do its job if the 9-EMA fails to support price.
